description: Dated IPO events across all US IPOs in a window: lock-up expiries (with lock-up length), quiet-period expiries, and listings with offer price, first-day open and close, first-day pop and close return versus the offer, and lead managers. Use it to find upcoming lock-up expiries (supply overhang), quiet-period ends (analyst initiations) or how recent deals traded on day one. Arguments: from and to as YYYY-MM-DD (default today to today + 30 days, at most 366 days), types as a subset of lockup_expiry, quiet_period_expiry, listing (default all). PREMIUM: paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base); an unpaid call returns the payment terms, and an empty window is never charged. Same data and price as the HTTP endpoint /api/agent/ipo-events.

from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC date). Defaults to today.

to.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive and at most 366 days after from. Defaults to from + 30 days.

types.description: Event types to include: lockup_expiry (with lock-up length), quiet_period_expiry, listing (with first-day pop, close return and lead managers). Defaults to all three.

name: get_ipo_events

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key: the registrant's permanent SEC identifier, as a 10-digit string with leading zeros, e.g. 0001876042.

company.description: Registrant name as filed with the SEC, e.g. Circle Internet Group, Inc.

exchange.description: Listing exchange: NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSEAMER (NYSE American) or OTC. Other venues verbatim.

firstDayClose.description: First-day closing price, USD, as printed (not split-adjusted).

firstDayOpen.description: First-day opening price, USD, as printed (not split-adjusted).

leadManagers.description: Lead underwriters, as IPOScoop lists them.

offerPrice.description: Offer price, USD per share. Null for a direct listing.

listing.description: listing events only: how the first day went.

lockupDays.description: lockup_expiry only: length of the lock-up in days, typically 180.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol the company trades under now, upper case, e.g. CRCL.

type.description: lockup_expiry (insiders may start selling), quiet_period_expiry (underwriters' analysts may start publishing) or listing (first trading day).

title: IPO events calendar (premium)
